## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 10, 2026 - Sep 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Revamped Rebel_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "basic features behind paywall. I was looking for a different app from renpho and heard good things about this app. imma just accept the new changes on renpho that I didn't like in exchange for this app not squeezing me."
            2. _Thursday_, Sep 10, 2026, 1/5: "I've used MFP for over a decade. It used to be the perfect app, but with each update they made it harder to navigate, more and more cumbersome, and they keep taking features we already had and putting them behind a paywall. The app used to be laid out so you could easily see all of your information right up front. Now you have to dig to try to find anything."
            3. _Adam Voth_, Sep 12, 2026, 3/5: "the paywall is too high..."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Sep 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _enka cacka_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"

            3. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
